facts.text: Jolene and her partner discussed how their loved ones' values have influenced their lives, specifically perseverance and resilience.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, my partner and I talked about how our loved ones have influenced us and what their values meant to us.
Our loved ones have taught us to persevere and stay resilient, like my mom always said to never give up, and my partner's dad showed them to stay determined.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner are pursuing their respective passions, with Jolene focusing on engineering and her partner on creative endeavors.

evidence.quote: Their values have influenced us to pursue our goals, such as me with engineering and my partner with their creative endeavors.

facts.text: Jolene intends to incorporate the values of her loved ones into her engineering projects, particularly the value of helping others.

evidence.quote: I'm keen on coming up with new ideas and making things more efficient to make the world a better place. Going further, my mom stressed the value of helping others and that's something I want to keep in mind for my engineering projects.
